description: Popis autobusnih, taxi i ostalih prijevoznika is a dataset listed in Open Data Portal Croatia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Grad Pula. List of intercity carriers, taxi services, bus and train station, hydroplane carrier. Coverage: Grad Pula. The portal shows the English title as "List of bus, taxi and other carriers" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Grad Pula. Its keywords include taxi, željeznički kolodvor, autobusni kolodvor, adresar. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV, XLS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-portal-otvorenih-podataka.
